:::{#exm-integral}
#### An integral with positive and negative parts

For the counting measure $\measure$ on the die rolls $D$,
let $f(x) = x - 3$.
Its values at $1, \ldots, 6$ are $-2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3$, so:

- $f^{+}$ has values $0, 0, 0, 1, 2, 3$,
  and $\int_D f^{+} \, d\measure = 6$ by @exm-integral-nonneg;
- $f^{-}$ has values $2, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0$,
  and $\int_D f^{-} \, d\measure = 3$;
- $\int_D f \, d\measure = 6 - 3 = 3$,
  which is also $\sum_{x \in D} (x - 3) = 21 - 18 = 3$.

:::
